steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Phew... We finally lost them.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: If we keep up the pace, we'll be out of the central region shortly and arrive at the southern exit.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: It's starting to get noisier and more chaotic...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: It might be because the Chernobog civilians trying to evacuate the city are running into Reunion.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: It seems like a few districts have already been vacated.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: But those who didn't make it in time are now being held up by Reunion.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: This place used to be a magificent, sprawling plaza.Now... it's been reduced to ruins.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: This city tormented the Infected. To meet their end this way is almost poetic.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Almost...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: You seem quite sentimental.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: Perhaps, at one point...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The sky's getting even darker.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Even the air has the smell... of something burning.

steps.name: Civilian
steps.text: What are you doing?!

steps.name: Civilian
steps.text: ...Aaaargh!! !

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: Civilians?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: I can't hear anything anymore.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: We can't tell who they are from this distance.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Reunion is attacking them...!

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: We can't leverage the terrain to our advantage here. We don't have the capacity to save everybody.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: Life is very precious, Amiya. Each and every one.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Regardless, we're already too late.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: After all, we're in for some trouble ourselves.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: We can't catch a break today.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: ...Kill them all.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: A large number of Reunion forces are coming through the exits!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Get ready to fight our way out!
